content.comment_body: Hello, Thanks for reading my question. I have purchased a starter pack that includes [product_name] and a basic panel for learning programming and building projects. The product type is [article_no]. Recently, I have been trying to convert an analog input (potentiometer 0-10V) to a delayed output. The challenge is connecting the analog amplifier's output (Ax) to the time input (T) of the off-delay block. Please refer to the attached image. I've attempted VM mapping but still can't draw a connection between the blocks. The screenshot shows my program on the left and an example program from the [company_name] website on the right. [url]
Also, see here: How can references between blocks be configured in [product_name]?

Thanks for responding promptly. I understand your answer, but it doesn't solve the issue. Please look at the attached screenshot. The amplifier block (Ax) isn't selectable for drawing a connection. Is this limitation specific to the [company_name] starter pack?
Issue resolved! I copied the block from the [company_name] example program. When I inserted a new block, everything worked as expected. Have a nice day.
A new question published by [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread with the topic [product_name] [article_no], setting time in on-delay timer. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered a challenge when attempting to connect an analog amplifier output to the time input of an off-delay block using [product_name] and related programming tools. Difficulty stemmed from being unable to link blocks as shown in the official example from [company_name]. Resolution was found by recreating the block, suggesting the issue was related to block initialization or interface behavior, rather than core functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to create connections between analog outputs and timer block inputs easily, replicating what is demonstrated in official example programs, and that the software interface will clearly support such operations.
